newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Fifteen die, 18 injured in Colombia bus plunge.
newsitem.headline: Fifteen die, 18 injured in Colombia bus plunge.

text.p: A bus flipped over and plunged into a 900-foot-deep (300 metre) ravine in southern Colombia, killing 15 people and leaving 18 injured, police said on Tuesday.
The accident took place Monday evening close to the town of La Florida as the bus travelled between the town of Pasto and Sandona in Narino province, on Colombia's southern border with Ecuador.
Police said the most likely cause of the crash was mechanical failure.
